req.title: Task update persists
req.statement: The system shall persist PUT changes so subsequent GET requests reflect the update.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that PUT /tasks/{task_id} persists changes so a subsequent GET reflects them. I design: (1) a positive EP/STC test that updates an existing task and verifies the GET response matches exactly; (2) a negative NEG test that PUTs to a non-existent task_id and asserts HTTP 404 with exact detail; (3) a BVA boundary test that updates only the title field to exactly 1 character (min_length boundary) and verifies persistence; (4) a DT test covering all three optional fields simultaneously; (5) a BVA test for title at max_length=100 chars. Each test uses an in-process TestClient with a fresh SQLite DB via dependency override, seeded with the pre-loaded rows, and asserts exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_put_persists_title_and_completed_reflected_by_get
preconditions: Task with id=7 exists: title='Fix login bug', completed=false
Database is seeded with pre-loaded rows
actions: Assert PUT response body fields match update payload
Assert GET response body reflects persisted changes
expected: PUT body: id=7, title='Fixed login bug', completed=true
GET body: id=7, title='Fixed login bug', completed=true
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import get_db

tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{tmp}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
db = SessionLocal()
db.add(models.Task(id=7, title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=False))
db.commit(); db.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try: yield db
    finally: db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_persists_title_and_completed_reflected_by_get():
    r_put = client.put('/tasks/7', json={'title': 'Fixed login bug', 'completed': True})
    assert r_put.status_code == 200
    body = r_put.json()
    assert body['id'] == 7
    assert body['title'] == 'Fixed login bug'
    assert body['completed'] == True
    r_get = client.get('/tasks/7')
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    g = r_get.json()
    assert g['id'] == 7
    assert g['title'] == 'Fixed login bug'
    assert g['completed'] == True

test_put_persists_title_and_completed_reflected_by_get()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
os.unlink(tmp)
